command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
# #997 MIGRATION — MIG-13. The thermal question the 150 W bench raised and could not answer.
#
# That bench ran 8 iterations, and the card went 54 -> 77 C climbing about 3 C per iteration with no
# sign of levelling off. 77 C is comfortably under the 92 C slowdown, but "not yet hot" and "will not
# get hot" are different claims, and #997 section 8 only permits evaluating 200 W after 150 W passes
# its THERMAL check. A rising curve truncated at 90 seconds is not a passing thermal check.
#
# So: cool to a real baseline, then soak at 150 W until the temperature either plateaus (< 1 C rise
# across a 90 s window) or hits the 85 C abort. Both outcomes are useful and both are honest. What
# would not be honest is escalating to 200 W on the strength of a peak that was still moving.
#
# Run under a one-shot Scheduled Task because a proper soak outlives any single session timeout.

$stage = 'D:\HermesServices\ollama\_install'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $stage | Out-Null

$soak = @'
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'
$smi  = 'C:\Windows\System32\nvidia-smi.exe'
$P40  = 'GPU-4f7d4396-9304-d12f-7e9b-7f04d1236fc2'
$log  = 'D:\HermesServices\ollama\_install\soak150.log'
$tele = 'D:\HermesServices\ollama\_install\soak150-telemetry.csv'
$ABORT_C = 85
function L($m) { "$((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')) $m" | Add-Content $log }
function Temp { [double]((& $smi --query-gpu=temperature.gpu --format=csv,noheader,nounits -i $P40 | Select-Object -First 1).Trim()) }

Remove-Item $log, $tele -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
L "SOAK START"

# --- cool-down baseline -------------------------------------------------------------------------
L "COOLDOWN begin temp=$(Temp)"
$deadline = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(6)
while ((Get-Date) -lt $deadline) {
    $t = Temp
    L "cooldown temp=$t"
    if ($t -le 45) { break }
    Start-Sleep -Seconds 20
}
$baseline = Temp
L "COOLDOWN end baseline=$baseline"

# --- soak ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
$p = Start-Process -FilePath $smi -PassThru -NoNewWindow -ArgumentList @(
    '-i', $P40,
    '--query-gpu=timestamp,temperature.gpu,power.draw,utilization.gpu,memory.used,clocks.sm,clocks_throttle_reasons.active',
    '--format=csv,noheader,nounits', '-l', '1', '-f', $tele)
L "telemetry pid=$($p.Id)"

$prompt = 'Explain in exhaustive technical detail how a device that presents no display adapter cannot be enumerated by a virtualisation layer that reaches hardware only through the display driver stack, and what that means for container runtimes that initialise the device library before applying any device filter. Cover enumeration order, initialisation side effects, and why per-device selectors arrive too late.'
$soakEnd = (Get-Date).AddMinutes(11)
$i = 0
$history = @()
$aborted = $false
$plateau = $false
while ((Get-Date) -lt $soakEnd) {
    $i++
    $t0 = Temp
    if ($t0 -ge $ABORT_C) { L "ABORT thermal ${t0}C >= ${ABORT_C}C at iter $i"; $aborted = $true; break }
    $sw = [Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
    try {
        $body = @{ model = 'qwen2.5-coder:7b'; prompt = $prompt; stream = $false; options = @{ num_predict = 320; temperature = 0.2 } } | ConvertTo-Json
        $g = Invoke-RestMethod 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate' -Method Post -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json' -TimeoutSec 900
        $sw.Stop()
        $d = if ($g.eval_duration -gt 0) { [math]::Round($g.eval_count / ($g.eval_duration / 1e9), 2) } else { 'UNKNOWN' }
        $t1 = Temp
        L "iter=$i t_start=$t0 t_end=$t1 wall_ms=$($sw.ElapsedMilliseconds) decode_tok=$($g.eval_count) decode_tok_s=$d"
        $history += [pscustomobject]@{ at = (Get-Date); temp = $t1 }
        # Plateau: less than 1 C of rise across the last 90 seconds of samples.
        $window = $history | Where-Object { $_.at -ge (Get-Date).AddSeconds(-90) }
        if ($window.Count -ge 4) {
            $rise = ($window[-1].temp - $window[0].temp)
            L "   window_samples=$($window.Count) rise_over_window=${rise}C"
            if ($rise -lt 1) { L "PLATEAU reached at $t1 C (rise ${rise}C over 90s)"; $plateau = $true; break }
        }
    } catch {
        $sw.Stop(); L "iter=$i FAILED $($_.Exception.Message)"; $aborted = $true; break
    }
}
$final = Temp
L "SOAK END iters=$i final_temp=$final aborted=$aborted plateau=$plateau baseline=$baseline"
try { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force -ErrorAction Stop; L 'telemetry stopped' } catch { L "telemetry stop err $($_.Exception.Message)" }
L "DONE"
'@
Set-Content -Path "$stage\soak150.ps1" -Value $soak -Encoding UTF8
Write-Output "soak_script_sha256=$((Get-FileHash "$stage\soak150.ps1" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower())"

$name = 'WilliamOS-MIG-997-Soak150'
Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName $name -Confirm:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
$action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute 'powershell.exe' -Argument "-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$stage\soak150.ps1`""
$principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal -UserId 'SYSTEM' -LogonType ServiceAccount -RunLevel Highest
$settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet -AllowStartIfOnBatteries -DontStopIfGoingOnBatteries -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Minutes 30)
Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $name -Action $action -Principal $principal -Settings $settings -Description '#997 one-shot: 150W thermal soak' | Out-Null
Start-ScheduledTask -TaskName $name
Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
Write-Output "task_state=$((Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName $name).State)"
Write-Output "start_temp=$(& 'C:\Windows\System32\nvidia-smi.exe' --query-gpu=temperature.gpu --format=csv,noheader -i 'GPU-4f7d4396-9304-d12f-7e9b-7f04d1236fc2')"
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
